product.description: Genuine replacement touch screen for the HP Envy x360 14-fc 2-in-1 convertible, 2.8K OLED configuration (2880x1800, adaptive 48-120Hz refresh, 0.2ms response time, SDR 400 nits / HDR 500 nits, 100% DCI-P3, edge-to-edge glass with micro-edge bezel, Corning Gorilla Glass NBT, multi-touch, IMAX-certified panel). Fits 14-fc0000-series units built with the 2.8K OLED panel, such as the 14-fc0005na, 14-fc0097nr and 14-fc0009na. Because the 14-fc series covers both WUXGA IPS and 2.8K OLED builds, send us your full model number or a photo of the sticker under your laptop on WhatsApp so we can confirm fit before dispatch. 360-degree hinge supports laptop, tent, stand and tablet modes. Tested before dispatch.

faqs.question: How do I know this is the right variant for my Envy x360 14-fc?
faqs.answer: The 14-fc series ships with two different touch panels: 2.8K OLED (this listing) and WUXGA IPS. Send us your full model number (e.g. 14-fc0005na or 14-fc0097nr) or a photo of the label under your laptop on WhatsApp and we'll confirm which one you need before you order.

faqs.question: Is it touch screen?
faqs.answer: Yes, this is a multi-touch OLED panel with adaptive 48-120Hz refresh and Corning Gorilla Glass NBT protection, matching the Envy x360's 360-degree convertible hinge.

faqs.question: What warranty comes with this screen?
faqs.answer: This screen carries a 3-month warranty against dead pixels and panel defects.
